newsitem.title: USA: Surety Capital Corp full results.
newsitem.headline: Surety Capital Corp full results.

text.p: C. Jack Bean, Chairman of the Board of Surety Capital, stated, "The first quarter of 1997 was another excellent quarter for Surety Capital. Earnings per share were $.09 for the quarter, as compared to $.06 for the first quarter in 1996. This represents a 50% increase in earnings per share over the same period in 1996. This increase was accomplished despite a 33% increase in the average shares of common stock outstanding during the first quarter of 1996. Net income for the first quarter of 1997 increased by 105% over the same period in 1996. Total assets decreased by 2% and total net loans increased by 29% for the first quarter of 1997, respectively, over the same period in 1996. The significantly higher growth of loans compared to assets highlights Surety's efforts to concentrate on asset utilization rather than asset growth. It should be noted that as a result, both net earnings and earnings per share are increasing at an even faster rate than loan growth. Once management considers Surety's assets to be fully utilized, Surety will return its focus to its traditional acquisition and asset growth strategy. We believe this strategy will prove to be of long-term benefit to both Surety and its shareholders."
Visit Surety on the world wide web at: http://www.sry.com or by e-mail: cjbean@sry.com. SOURCE Surety Capital Corporation
